## Evidence for inclusion criteria

- **Offline reopening of saved work** *(for web apps, explain how it works offline across reloads)*:
- **Independent copy (backup / reusable export / user-controlled files):**

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and the project meets the strict local-first inclusion criteria.
- [ ] Primary user data is stored locally and saved work can be reopened offline (across reloads for web apps).
- [ ] Users can back up or move their data independently without the vendor's service.
- [ ] Application supports multi-device sync/collaboration **or** builds on sync-oriented data structures (not a purely local-only app, one-off utility, or config-only system utility). *(N/A for Libraries/Protocols.)*
- [ ] License status is accurately disclosed (proprietary/source-available labeled; open-source repo has a `LICENSE` file).
- [ ] All network requirements, cloud features, accounts, telemetry/analytics, update/license checks, and initial model downloads are disclosed accurately.
- [ ] The project is publicly usable today (early-access/alpha labeled if applicable).
- [ ] The entry is in alphabetical order, uses a clean canonical URL (no `?ref=`/`utm_*`), and has a concise, factual description.
